directorates._note: 2026/27 pressure GBP 41.079m, the largest single pressure.

directorates._note: About GBP 24.5m of the GBP 55.3m programme is corporate finance (debt, MRP, pension, operating model), not service cuts.

cross_cutting._note: 2026/27 savings programme GBP 55.332m (GBP 42.956m new + GBP 12.375m prior-year); the directorate engine risk-adjusts it to GBP 39.73m EV. About GBP 24.5m is corporate finance, not service cuts.

reserves._note: General reserve GBP 35m (minimum raised from under GBP 25m to about GBP 35m); earmarked GBP 165.4m. No reserves draw planned to fund the 2026/27 budget.

risks.risk: DSG High Needs deficit forecast about GBP 84.6m by end 2025/26, held off the General Fund by a statutory override that ends 31 March 2028. Derbyshire is in both the DfE Safety Valve and Delivering Better Value programmes; the budget assumes Government takes on SEND funding responsibility from April 2028.

Forward MTFP gap rising steeply: GBP 1.589m (2027/28), GBP 33.453m (2028/29), GBP 51.421m (2029/30), GBP 68.545m (2030/31), cumulative about GBP 155m. As a shire county, Derbyshire's funding reduces over the next 3 years under the funding reforms.

About GBP 24.5m of the GBP 55.3m 2026/27 savings is corporate finance (debt charges, MRP not used, pension-contribution reduction, operating model), not recurring service savings, so the underlying service-savings base is thinner than the headline.
A GBP 0.422m prior-year Adult Social Care saving (Supplies and Third-Party Payments) is recorded as not achievable, a delivery-risk signal on the ASC programme.
